messages.subject: HTML text in tabset
parts:
There's probably an obvious fix to this that I'm missing: if I have a chart in a tabset, and I want to put explanatory text beneath it, how do I do it?

Example app is here - 
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/psychemedia/f1ergastdemo/

thanks
tony

PS by the by, I need a better fix to the nominated driver result, vs "All" results. Any ideas?

messages.author: c584965fac2b99d6
messages.subject: Re: HTML text in tabset
parts:
Making a start on answering my own question - also pass a textOutput element from the tab definition in ui.R, eg:
tabPanel("Race Summary", plotOutput("raceSummary"),textOutput('raceSummaryDesc'))

I tried to handle this in the server with something like:

  output$raceSummaryDesc=reactiveUI(function(){
    div("The",em("Race Summary Chart"),"is intended to provide an at glance summary of driver positions at notable parts of the race:
        on the grid, at the end of the first lap, and at the end of the race. The range of race positions held throughout the race is also shown.")
  })

but it doesn't quite work, in the the html tags appear literally in the displayed text, rather than being used/handled/interpreted/parsed as HTML tags?

<div> The <em>Race Summary Chart</em> is intended to provide an at glance summary of driver positions at notable parts of the race: on the grid, at the end of the first lap, and at the end of the race. The range of race positions held throughout the race is also shown. </div>

So what am I doing wrong?

tony

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: HTML text in tabset
parts:
Either the latter (wrap a string in HTML()) or else the div("Some",em("Example"),"text.") syntax you used originally.

For completeness, there's also includeHTML which lets you put the HTML in a separate file, and includeMarkdown which is the same but with a Markdown file.
